command:
export KUBECONFIG=/tmp/managed-cluster-01.kubeconfig
kubectl get policyreport -A -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d,indent=2)[:9000])'
kubectl get --raw '/api/v1/namespaces/kof/services/kof-collectors-opencost:9003/proxy/allocation/compute?window=10m&aggregate=node' | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print("code",d.get("code")); print([(k,v.get("properties")) for s in d.get("data",[]) for k,v in s.items()])'
unset KUBECONFIG
helm list -A
kubectl -n kof get vmalert
